'''Luco''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on [[Nirama's public asteroid]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. He was sometimes seen in [[Hutt's Tail]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] running a game that involved shuffling three chips. He was quite skilled at cheating using sleight-of-hand tricks, and took in a lot of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] with his game.
